english_title: Dominated Convergence Theorem for Convergence in Probability
statement_en:
If random variables $X_n\xrightarrow{P}{X}$, and if $|X_n|\leq Y$ with $E(Y)$ finite, then
$$E(X_n)\to E(X).$$
final_code:

open MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal

theorem tendsto_expectation_of_tendstoInProbability_dominated

    (X : Ω → ℝ) (Xn : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (Y : Ω → ℝ)
    (hprob :
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n : ℕ => μ {ω | ε ≤ |Xn n ω - X ω|})
          Filter.atTop

    (hdom : ∀ n ω, |Xn n ω| ≤ Y ω)
    (hY : Integrable Y μ) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => ∫ ω, Xn n ω ∂μ)
      Filter.atTop
      (nhds (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ)) := by
